components.name: Primary action
components.description: Filled teal action for committing the main form task.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--teal); padding: 0 20px; color: var(--white); font: 700 16px/24px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); } .ds-button-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-aqua); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Outlined teal action for a useful secondary path.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--teal); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--white); padding: 0 20px; color: var(--teal); font: 700 16px/24px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--teal-soft); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-aqua); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Full-width white field with a light border and generous touch height.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Species name<input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search or enter a name"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; color: var(--ink); font: 600 14px/20px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; margin-top: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--white); padding: 0 16px; color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/20px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--teal); outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(8 127 120 / 0.15); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-aqua); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Surface card
components.description: White content surface separated from the pale page canvas.
components.html:
Selected water

Manila Bay

Place information sits in a calm, readable panel.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 24px; background: var(--white); padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/24px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 8px 0 4px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 28px; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); } .ds-card .ds-eyebrow { color: var(--teal); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Application navigation
components.description: Compact rounded links with a quiet teal active state.
components.html: ExploreMy CatchesSettings
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(219 230 230 / 0.8); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.95); padding: 8px; font: 600 14px/20px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; color: #475569; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #f1f5f9; color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link-active { background: var(--teal-soft); color: var(--teal-dark); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-aqua); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Review status chip
components.description: Warm capsule that makes pending or review status easy to spot.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fffbeb; padding: 8px 16px; color: #78350f; font: 700 12px/16px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fbbf24; }

components.name: Selected map marker
components.description: Circular numbered location control with a white rim and clear selected state.
components.css: .ds-map-marker { display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; place-items: center; border: 3px solid #fff; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--teal); color: var(--white); font: 800 14px/20px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); transform: scale(1.1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-map-marker:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-aqua); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like a clear, well-kept field guide: steady, local, and easy to scan. A pale bay-mist canvas, dark ink typography, and deep teal accents make the page feel calm without losing the confidence needed for clear actions and selected states.

Keep the map illustration and area selector visually legible and purposeful. Use compact, letter-spaced overlines to orient the reader, then let large, tightly tracked headings and quiet supporting copy establish hierarchy. Bilog appears as a small, warm illustration in the current prototype; keep that artwork supportive rather than making it the interface's main visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Field-guide clarity with a calm, coastal palette.
Strong ink-and-teal hierarchy with generous breathing room.
Friendly rounded controls and cards, kept visually restrained.

rules.name: The Review-Color Rule
rules.body: Keep amber for review or warning information and rose for errors; neither becomes a general brand accent.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Use the border and surface contrast to define a resting card; reserve stronger shadow for small interactive markers.

dos: Do keep the map, place choices, and their selected state easy to distinguish at a glance.
Do use deep teal for actions and selection, and keep headings anchored in ink.
Do pair warning and error colors with direct labels or supporting text.
Do preserve the light border, soft shadow, and rounded-card balance.
Do keep the 3px keyboard-focus treatment visible and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't add faux-nautical decoration such as ropes, anchors, weathered paper, or generic fishing clip art.
Don't use amber as a general accent or let status color replace a readable label.
Don't spread shadows across every surface; use them for quiet separation and map-marker lift.
Don't use the map's illustrated gradients and organic land shapes as a general page background treatment.
